“No problem,” Lin Yuan agreed without hesitation.

It’s meant to be kept secret.

Lin Yuan never had the intention to share it.

Such an extremely private life-saving secret technique, wouldn’t sharing it be like revealing one’s own weaknesses?

“Good,” the Six-Armed Silhouette nodded, “Repeat after me.”

“I, disciple of Xuanhuang, swear by the Xuan Huang Seal, I shall absolutely not disclose the Xuan Huang Lineage’s Dao-Protection Secret Skill, should I break this oath, may my soul perish.”

...

The Six-Armed Silhouette looked at Lin Yuan.

“I, disciple of Xuanhuang, swear by the Xuan Huang Seal, I shall absolutely not disclose the Xuan Huang Lineage’s Dao-Protection Secret Skill, should I break this oath, may my soul perish.”

Lin Yuan pondered and then recited.

The moment Lin Yuan finished reciting, a mark resembling a majestic earthy yellow mountain formed from the depths of his soul and then quickly disappeared.

“Xuan Huang Seal?” Lin Yuan was slightly stirred inside.

Besides the Xuan Huang Seal, there was also the Magic Jade Mark deep within his soul.

“All right,” the Six-Armed Silhouette breathed a slight sigh of relief.

“You practice the Xuan Huang Evolutionary Path, naturally forming the Xuan Huang Seal. I know you are a being from within the universe, capable of being resurrected by a supreme existence, but this oath rooted deep in your memory will continue to end your life if you die because of it, even if resurrected, as long as the memory remains, the cycle of death will persist without end,”

“Don’t worry,” Lin Yuan nodded.

“But rest assured, as long as you do not spread the secret technique, there will be no issues,” said the Six-Armed Silhouette.

“Yes,” Lin Yuan was also aware.

The oath he made bubbled with numerous pieces of information in his mind, each word clear and indisputable, leaving no room for doubts.

…

“This is the safest place in the secret realm, refine the Core of the Secret Realm here,” said the Six-Armed Silhouette, then disappeared.

“Refine the Core of the Secret Realm.”

Lin Yuan took a deep breath.

Immediately, he sat cross-legged, took out the earthy yellow crystal, and began to slowly refine it by infusing the power of the world.

“Hmm?”

“So this is what the Xuanhuang Secret Realm actually looks like?” Lin Yuan saw the true nature of the Xuanhuang Secret Realm through the Core of the Secret Realm.

The Xuanhuang Secret Realm consisted of three vast continents, with numerous Ninth Rank strong beings from the cosmic starry sky only entering one of these continents.

The other two continents, not opened and shrouded in deep mysteries, were unnoticed by any strong being except Lin Yuan and the Six-Armed Silhouette.

“This Xuanhuang Secret Realm is too incredible, no wonder it has evaded the detection of all supreme beings,” as he continued to refine the Core of the Secret Realm, Lin Yuan’s understanding of the Xuanhuang Secret Realm deepened.

The Xuanhuang Secret Realm was not located within a specific spatial layer but existed in the gaps between spatial layers, shifting its position along with the countless changing spatial layers of the universe.

It can be said,

the location of the Xuanhuang Secret Realm is constantly changing, which is why supreme beings cannot accurately pinpoint it.

…

Milky Way Main Star.

Lin Yuan sat cross-legged.

In the Xuanhuang Secret Realm, his Taiyang Divine Spirit was fully engaged in refining the Core of the Secret Realm, striving to gain control over the entire Xuanhuang Secret Realm as soon as possible.

Meanwhile, Lin Yuan’s actual body was comprehending the three Dao-Protecting Secret Skills of the Profound Yellow Lineage.

As for the Rule of Time? There’s no rush for the Rule of Time, advancing from Ninth Rank to Tenth Rank does not demand it.

But mastering each level of the three secret techniques grants Lin Yuan a significant boost in strength.

“The Primordial Yellow Physique requires refining, needing a large amount of ‘Xuanhuang Origin’? Also known as the ‘Xuanhuang Crystal’.” Lin Yuan smiled.

Currently, he had an abundance of Xuanhuang Crystals, with the supply from millennia in the Xuanhuang Secret Realm piling up like a small mountain.

“Once I completely take control of the Xuanhuang Secret Realm, let the Taiyang Divine Spirit bring out some of the Xuanhuang Crystals,” Lin Yuan decided.

As long as these Xuanhuang Crystals are not circulated, there would be no impact, and if he alone practices, how would others know?

Time passes.

Two years went by in the blink of an eye.

…

Virtual World.

Within a personal space.

Lin Yuan and Xilan sat facing each other, savoring exotic foods.

“This roasted dragon meat, even as a delicacy in the Virtual World, mustn’t be cheap, right? It must cost at least a few Cubic Universe Crystals to taste?” Xilan looked at the half-meter-long leg of meat in front of her and couldn’t help but comment.

The roasted dragon, a special life form from the depths of the cosmic starry sky, matures at Fifth Rank.

What makes roasted dragon most famous is its flesh, savory and tender; when specially prepared, its taste is unparalleled in all of human civilization.

Unfortunately, because roasted dragons cannot be domesticated, every pound of roasted dragon meat must be obtained through combat.

This has kept the price of roasted dragon meat perennially high.

In the Virtual World, the roasted dragon meat, retaining only its flavor and devoid of any real effects, still costs several Cubic Universe Crystals per beast.

“Hahahaha,” Lin Yuan took a bite of the roasted dragon meat, a look of enjoyment spreading across his face.

In fact, the roasted dragon meat in front of him wasn’t purchased by Lin Yuan, but was a gift from the Virtual World.

Being an eighth-level citizen comes with its perks, including monthly benefits. Not to mention the virtual world’s roasted dragon meat, even the real-world version gets delivered, albeit in much smaller quantities.

“Galaxy Master, your reputation now stands unique among the Ninth Rank circle. Those special Ninth Ranks turn pale at the sight of you, and the Ninth Rank Alien Race in the Xuanhuang Secret Realm dare not show their faces…,” Xilan said, her face breaking into a smile.

Despite the many openings of the Xuanhuang Secret Realm, the Ninth Rank Evolvers of human civilization, while not much harmed, have also not gained much advantage.

Even when human civilization gives rise to a powerful Ninth Rank Evolver during some special periods, they would still prompt a united front from other special Ninth Ranks within the Xuanhuang Secret Realm.
